1.title: Ocasio-Cortez Opened Up About Freezing her Eggs. She Got Women Talking.
1.summary: Many women say being open about the fertility treatment is a form of empowerment. But critics say all the talk can be misleading.

2.title: University of Michigan Will Ease Up on Grades for Student Mental Health
2.summary: The university will make first-semester grades pass or fail, to encourage students to try different classes and lessen fears of what a low grade could mean.

3.title: What to Watch in Tuesday’s Primary Elections in Wisconsin, Minnesota and South Carolina
3.summary: The left and the middle continue to battle in Democratic primaries for governor in Wisconsin and Senate in Minnesota. In South Carolina, all eyes are on Darline Graham.

4.title: Former judge removed by Orbán elected Hungarian president
4.summary: Since taking office in early May, the new Hungarian government has lost no time dismantling Viktor Orbán's legacy.

5.title: Four Killed in Houthi Strike on Red Sea Ship, Yemeni Government Says
5.summary: The Yemeni government said the ship was carrying food supplies to a port on the Bab al-Mandab Strait while the Iran-backed Houthis accused Saudi Arabia of transporting weapons.

6.title: Russia releases former US Marine reported in poor health
6.summary: Trump said Robert Gilman, who was arrested in 2022, was released on a humanitarian basis, after he had reportedly been in a catatonic-like state.
